title: Horton 2025-03 Semifinal Kingdom 2: Divine Wind, Witch, Mountain Shrine, Save

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: March 2025 Tournament Summary; Semifinal Kingdom 2, designed and playtested by Horton

quality_note: Designer explains the intent and a few priorities; the post-Divine-Wind kingdom was hidden from players, so the plan is partly speculative.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule: players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening. Divine Wind: the 10 replacement Kingdom piles were chosen by the organizer in advance and are hidden from the players until the Prophecy triggers.
